description:
Searches notes and logs and summarises activity by thread. Returns pointers (an absolute path plus metadata), never document bodies. Read a result with `notes cat` or by opening its path.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text S] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — find notes
  logs [--thread T] [--text S] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — find daily logs
  activity [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a date window
  overview THREAD [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread
  stream [--thread T] [--kind K] [--text S] [--today] [--reverse] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — every dated record, merged into one chronology

Flags:
  common:
    --thread T  thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
    --since D   on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    --until D   on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    --json      JSON output
  notes:
    --type TYPE  note type, e.g. Meeting; case-insensitive
    --text S     case-insensitive literal, matched against topic and body
    --limit N    maximum results. Default 20; 0 returns all.
  logs:
    --text S   case-insensitive literal, matched against entry lines
    --limit N  maximum results. Default 20; 0 returns all.
  overview:
    THREAD     required positional
    --limit N  number of recent items to list. Default 5; 0 lists all.
  stream:
    --kind K   comma-separated list from: note, log, task, done, hours, payment, thread, person, pending. Default: all kinds.
    --text S   case-insensitive literal, matched against thread and summary
    --today    today only
    --reverse  oldest first. Default is newest first.
    --limit N  maximum events. Default 100; 0 returns all.

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--type", "Meeting", "--since", "2026-09-01"]
  ["overview", "Projects/SGB"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "note,log,task"]
  ["activity", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--until", "2026-09-30"]

Notes:
  Dates are event dates: a note's frontmatter timestamp, not its filename.
  Hours descriptions are not searched by --text.
  Read-only.
  Exit code 1 means an unknown value in --kind.
